memberships.page_title: The Common Cover of the Descendant Ladder
A 38-Dimensional Hessian Quartic from Five Reduction Strategies
Bounds and Obstructions for Symmetric Dilations

statement: For any Keller map F, the symmetric double (F(x),JF(x)^T y) is polynomially right-equivalent to F times the identity, so the 38-variable gradient descendant has the same generic degree and monodromy as the 19-variable cubic map.
